sessions.name: project-setup
sessions.prompt: Use $manage-project-workflow. This is a fresh Project session. Run context once. Set PROJECT Goal to 'Validate reproducible Project/Task handoffs' and Scope to 'One local text fixture and its deterministic verification'. Set Current Goal to 'Complete one isolated handoff check'. Create only Task harness-loop-check with Final Goal 'Create and verify a deterministic text result'. Complete its TASK Scope, Workflow, Outputs, Completion Criteria and STATUS Work Plan so ready validation can pass. Do not activate it or launch another session; stop at the human session-switch boundary.

sessions.name: task-work
sessions.prompt: Use $run-task-workflow. This is the independent Task session. Run context once and execute the TASK contract. Create the small result, verify it with a deterministic command, complete REPORT, make Work Plan and Current Work consistent, set Status completed, validate the completed phase, and stop for the human Project-session switch.

sessions.name: project-close
sessions.prompt: Use $manage-project-workflow. This is a new Project session after the human switch. Run context once, use the pending handoff, run deterministic handoff validation and audit, then close harness-loop-check. Promotion was not requested: do not copy results or record a Promotion decision.
